headline: Portugal not showing "necessary urgency" on housing crisis, warns Bank of Portugal
summary: The governor of the Bank of Portugal warned that the country is not showing the necessary urgency to address the housing situation. He referred to both public and private housing investment.
why: The Bank of Portugal is the country's central bank and financial supervisor. Housing affordability and supply affect household credit risk and inflation in Portugal.
